units.source_text: 元旦的仪式完成之后，今年的游艺是表演男踏歌[\[18\]](#part1335.html#m18)。

en.t: After the New Year's Day ceremonies were over, this year's entertainment was a performance of the men's stomping songs.

units.source_text: 青年贵公子们照例奔走各处，熙熙攘攘，热闹非凡。

en.t: As usual, the young noblemen hurried about from place to place, creating a lively and bustling scene.
Prince Genji too was busy for a time.

units.source_text: 但他惦记那岑寂的邸宅里的末摘花，觉得她很可怜。

en.t: But he kept thinking of Suetsumuhana in that lonely mansion, and felt very sorry for her.

units.source_text: 初七日的节会[\[19\]](#part1335.html#m19)结束之后，到了夜里，

en.t: After the festival gathering on the seventh day was over, when night came,

units.source_text: 他从宫中退出，装作回到他的宫中值宿所（桐壶院）去宿夜的样子，

en.t: he withdrew from the palace and made it look as though he were returning to his night-duty quarters at the Kiritsubo residence to spend the night,

units.source_text: 便在夜深时分前去访问常陆亲王的宫邸。

en.t: then, late at night, went to visit the residence of Prince Hitachi.
